rules.unit: hours of approved Category I CME
rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I (Preapproved) by AAPA, AMA, AOACCME, AAFP, ACCME or an ACCME-recognized state medical society
rules.alternatives: NCCPA certification (or another qualified certifying body determined by the Board) at the time of renewal satisfies the CME requirement.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial license runs 13-24 months to the birth month; CME is due for the period immediately preceding expiration.
rules.audit_note: Random audits (16 CCR 1399.617); respond within 65 days. Keep CME records 4 years; if NCCPA-certified, submit verification when audited.

topics.who: PAs with an active license, practice-agreement authority to furnish Schedule II drugs and a DEA registration: one-time Board-standard course on Schedule II drugs and addiction risk (16 CCR 1399.610, 1399.612); send certificate to Board
PAs in primary care whose patients are over 25% aged 65+: at least 20% of CME in geriatric medicine, dementia care or care of older patients (BPC 3524.6)

rules.notes: Since 2022 CME courses with a direct patient care component must include implicit bias content (BPC 3524.5). Renewal fee $300 plus CURES fee $30 (licenses expiring on/after Jul 1, 2025). No CME extensions; waivers for health, military or hardship.
rules.legal_basis: California Code of Regulations, title 16, section 1399.615
